listing.name: One Must Fall 2097 / OpenOMF (omf2097)
listing.summary: Explore One Must Fall 2097 / OpenOMF (omf2097) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Start the managed Windows player
steps.instruction: The official archive includes the freeware One Must Fall 2097 resources and the native OpenOMF player. Choose Play after installation; no commercial source files or generation step are needed. The package also includes an ARM64 player; this route uses openomf.exe for x86-64.

steps.title: Open the upstream Linux AppImage
steps.instruction: Choose the stable x86-64 AppImage and use your Linux system’s AppImage support. Keep it executable. It includes the freeware resources and its own SDL2 libraries.

steps.title: Prepare the upstream Apple Silicon package
steps.instruction: Extract the stable Apple Silicon ZIP into a separate folder. If it contains usr/bin/openomf, check the Homebrew library requirements below and keep the entire usr tree. Set OPENOMF_RESOURCE_PATH to the absolute path to the extracted usr/share/games/openomf folder when launching that player. If the package instead contains OpenOMF.app, keep the app intact and follow its release instructions.

warnings: You and upstream maintain the Linux and Mac packages. Back up the configuration and state folders your copy actually uses before replacement. An explicit OPENOMF_CONFIG_PATH or OPENOMF_STATE_PATH can change those locations.

references.title: Check the inspected stable packages
references.instruction: The 0.8.6 AppImage player needs glibc 2.34 or later. The separate 0.8.6 Linux TAR.GZ needs glibc 2.43 and system libraries. The loose 0.8.6 Apple Silicon ZIP needs macOS 14 and Homebrew libepoxy, confuse, enet, sdl2_mixer, libxmp, libpng, opusfile, miniupnpc, libnatpmp and sdl2-compat. The binary loads specific library versions from /opt/homebrew. The macOS 15 app layout was observed on the separate rolling channel.

references.title: Find the effective OpenOMF profile
references.instruction: After explicit OpenOMF overrides, upstream checks XDG_CONFIG_HOME for configuration and XDG_STATE_HOME for state, then the SDL preference directory. Preserve settings, saves, scores, recordings, screenshots and user mods at their effective locations.

presentation.manual_preparation: The official archive includes the freeware One Must Fall 2097 resources and the native OpenOMF player. Choose Play after installation; no commercial source files or generation step are needed. The package also includes an ARM64 player; this route uses openomf.exe for x86-64. OpenOMF resolves writable settings, saves, scores, screenshots, recordings and user mods through its OpenOMF user-preference directory, normally AppData/OpenOMF on Windows. That external data remains outside Portcove backups. Package resources and bundled mods remain version-owned; no in-folder player-data paths are declared. Use an external registration for custom OPENOMF_* storage overrides. Existing external installations keep their files and runtime update owner. Gameplay, platform minimums and packaged Desktop acceptance remain separate observations.
